quote: Boundless compassion for all living beings is the surest and most certain guarantee of pure moral conduct, and needs no casuistry.
source: Arthur Schopenhauer, The Basis of Morality, Part III, Chapter VIII, (4) (trans. Arthur Brodrick Bullock, 1903)
